sub_mechanism: Class.forName(...).newInstance() with package-private ctor -> no allocation
rationale: ClassNewInstanceContextInterpreter only models newInstance for a public no-arg ctor; NestedDB's package-private ctor yields no allocation so db's points-to set is empty.

sub_mechanism: JAXP DocumentBuilderFactory.newDocumentBuilder reflective factory, empty receiver
rationale: No model for the JAXP factory chain, so DocumentBuilderImpl is never allocated and the setErrorHandler receiver's points-to set stays empty.

sub_mechanism: JAXP DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance reflective factory, empty receiver
rationale: dbf comes from DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance() (JDK FactoryFinder reflection) which WALA does not model, so the receiver has empty points-to and getClass() is dropped.

sub_mechanism: custom-classloader class defined from byte array, absent from class hierarchy
rationale: lib.IntComparator is defined at runtime from a byte array via ByteClassLoader, never enters WALA's class hierarchy, so newInstance produces no allocation type.

sub_mechanism: reflective newInstance with non-constant class name (System property)
rationale: The class name is not a string constant (from System/Properties.getProperty), so ClassFactoryContextSelector assigns no concrete type, the reflectively created object is empty, and getField dispatch finds no receiver.

sub_mechanism: Class.getDeclaredFields0 native unmodeled -> empty Field
rationale: getDeclaredField uses native getDeclaredFields0 which has no stub, so the Field local has empty points-to and setAccessible dispatch never fires.

sub_mechanism: Class.getDeclaredFields0 native unmodeled -> empty Field
rationale: getDeclaredFields bottoms out in unmodeled native getDeclaredFields0, so the Field parameter has empty points-to and getModifiers dispatch finds nothing.

sub_mechanism: Class.getDeclaredFields0 native unmodeled -> empty Field
rationale: getDeclaredFields bottoms out in native getDeclaredFields0 which has no model, so no Field instance key exists and setAccessible dispatches on an empty receiver.

sub_mechanism: Class.getDeclaredFields0 native unmodeled -> empty Field cascade
rationale: The Field[] from getDeclaredFields has no elements because getDeclaredFields0 is unmodeled, so the Field parameter is empty and the getName/substring/toUpperCase chain is dropped.

sub_mechanism: Class.getDeclaredFields0 native unmodeled -> empty Field cascade
rationale: getDeclaredFields0 is unmodeled so the Field[] is empty, no BoundFields are built, and the toString receiver in write() has empty points-to.

sub_mechanism: Field.get factory model never activated (Field not a recognized reflective type)
rationale: isReflectiveType only recognizes Constructor/Method, so the Field receiver gets no ConstantKey and the Field.get factory model is never applied.

sub_mechanism: Field.get returns Malleable placeholder, filtered to empty by checkcast
rationale: natives.xml models Field.get as returning the Malleable placeholder, which the checkcast filter drops, leaving the receiver points-to set empty.

sub_mechanism: Method.invoke synthetic IR omits autoboxing of primitive return
rationale: ReflectiveInvocationInterpreter returns the primitive boolean verbatim without allocating a Boolean, so the booleanValue receiver has an empty points-to set.

sub_mechanism: Proxy.newProxyInstance unmodeled; $Proxy0 not in hierarchy
rationale: No model for Proxy.newProxyInstance, so the JVM-synthesized $Proxy0 never gets an instance key and the interface dispatch has an empty receiver.

sub_mechanism: annotation proxy ($Proxy2) from Field.getAnnotation, not in hierarchy
rationale: Field.getAnnotation returns a runtime-generated annotation proxy ($Proxy2) absent from the hierarchy, so the name() interface dispatch has an empty receiver.

sub_mechanism: annotation proxy ($Proxy4) from getAnnotation, not in hierarchy
rationale: The annotation receiver is a runtime-generated com.sun.proxy.$Proxy4 absent from WALA's class hierarchy, so no ConcreteTypeKey ever reaches the annotationType dispatch.

sub_mechanism: annotation proxy ($Proxy6) from Method.getAnnotation, not in hierarchy
rationale: No model for Method.getAnnotation and $Proxy6 is a runtime-generated annotation proxy absent from the hierarchy, so the timeout() interface dispatch has an empty receiver.

sub_mechanism: MethodHandle.invoke unmodeled under 0-CFA
rationale: The MethodHandle model is never activated and no summary exists for invoke(), so its return value is unconstrained and Object.toString() dispatches to no Demo type.

sub_mechanism: implicit AIOOBE from array-access PEI (no new bytecode)
rationale: addExceptionDefConstraints models the PEI exception only as a ConcreteTypeKey points-to constraint and never emits a constructor call edge.

sub_mechanism: implicit ClassCastException from checkcast (no new bytecode)
rationale: visitCheckCast only creates type-filter constraints; the implicit ClassCastException allocation+constructor produces no SSA invoke, so no edge is added.

sub_mechanism: implicit NPE from null-receiver invoke (no new bytecode)
rationale: WALA models the JVM-implicit NPE only as an exception-flow ConcreteTypeKey constraint and never synthesizes a constructor call edge.

sub_mechanism: implicit NPE from null-receiver invoke (no new bytecode)
rationale: The NPE is JVM-synthesized at a null dereference; addExceptionDefConstraints only makes a ConcreteTypeKey constraint and never an edge to NullPointerException.<init>.

sub_mechanism: implicit NoClassDefFoundError from unresolved invokestatic (linkage)
rationale: getImplicitExceptionTypes excludes linkage errors for invokestatic and WALA has no model for JVM-internal exception allocation, so only a CFG edge to the handler is made, not a constructor edge.

sub_mechanism: implicit NoSuchMethodError from unresolved method (linkage)
rationale: resolveMethod returns null for the missing method and WALA records no callee, never modeling the JVM-synthesized NoSuchMethodError.<init>.

sub_mechanism: implicit exception chaining (initCause) on linkage error at invokestatic
rationale: getImplicitExceptionTypes returns empty for invokestatic, so WALA never models the JVM-native linkage-error allocation or the resulting initCause call.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe Object accessors (get/put/CAS ObjectVolatile) unmodeled, via ConcurrentHashMap
rationale: The Log4jMarker is laundered through ConcurrentHashMap whose Object-typed Unsafe accessors are unmodeled, so the value returned by getMarker has empty points-to and setParents is dropped.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.compareAndSwapObject unmodeled (direct)
rationale: natives.xml omits compareAndSwapObject, so the swapped-in object is never propagated to the field and the virtual dispatch sees an empty receiver.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.getAndSetObject unmodeled (direct)
rationale: No model of getAndSetObject's atomic field-write side effect, so UnsafeTarget is never propagated into the field's points-to set.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.getAndSetObject/getObjectVolatile unmodeled (direct)
rationale: getAndSetObject's internal native getObjectVolatile is unmodeled, so its return value is empty and the virtual dispatch on it is dropped.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.getObject unmodeled (direct)
rationale: getObject(Object,long) has no summary; the native return generates no constraints so the variable receiving it has an empty points-to set.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.getObject unmodeled, via AtomicReferenceArray.get
rationale: Entries read via AtomicReferenceArray.get -> native Unsafe.getObject are lost, so StrongValueReference never flows into enqueueNotification's parameter.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.getObjectVolatile unmodeled (direct)
rationale: getObjectVolatile has no summary so its return value flows no instance key, leaving the dispatch receiver empty.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.getObjectVolatile unmodeled, via AtomicReferenceArray.get
rationale: AtomicReferenceArray.get delegates to unmodeled Unsafe.getObjectVolatile, so the array-read result has empty points-to and copyEntry's receiver is empty.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.getObjectVolatile unmodeled, via ConcurrentHashMap.tabAt
rationale: ConcurrentHashMap.get/tabAt reads nodes through unmodeled Unsafe.getObjectVolatile, so the map value and its List field have empty points-to and iterator() is dropped.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.putObject unmodeled (direct)
rationale: No model for putObject(Object,long,Object), so no heap-write constraint flows the instance into the field and the receiver stays empty.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.putObjectVolatile unmodeled (direct)
rationale: putObjectVolatile is unmodeled, so the stored object is never flowed into the field and only the ordinary putfield type is seen.

sub_mechanism: Unsafe.putOrderedObject unmodeled (direct)
rationale: putOrderedObject has no model, so the write is a no-op and the instance never enters the field's points-to set.

sub_mechanism: Class.forName0 descriptor mismatch (3-arg stub vs 4-arg JDK8 native)
rationale: natives.xml's forName0 stub has the wrong descriptor for JDK8's 4-arg native, so the forName result Class has empty points-to and getCanonicalName dispatch fails.
